rumdhan mafrudh 3la-l-muslimin il-kull, ama l-murdha w-li-msafrin ma-lazimhum-sh ysumu.
shhar rumdhan ma-yji-sh dima fi-nafs il-waqt 3la khatir il-3am il-hijri aqsar m-il-3am il-miladi, hathaka 3lash rumdhan yqaddim kull 3am b-7dash-in yum. in-nas ysumu m-is-sba7 l-il-lil. la yaklu w-la yushrbu w-la yitkayyfu.
in-nas yqumu m3a l-fajr qbal-ma tatla3 ish-shams bash yitsahhru w-ba3dha ysalliu slat is-subh. w-min ba3d yirj3u yurqdu.

waqt shaqqan il-fatr famma nas ysalliu f-ij-jami3, w-min ba3d yshuqqu ftarhum. ba3d shaqqan il-fatr barsha nas yitfarriju f-it-talfza 3la khatir jibu musalsalat b-baramij diniya. famma rjal yhibbu yashru f-il-qhawi, ama n-nsa yuq3du f-id-dyar walla ytullu 3la ba3dhum. ahla shahriyat rumdhan 3la khatir il-3ayilat ytullu 3la ba3dhum w-yashru l-is-sba7, khassatan iz-zlabya w-li-mkharaq.

B: tawwa madhi sa3a.
A: win qa3da fatma?
B: hiyya qa3da f-il-mat3am.
A: shnuwwa l-waqt tawwa?
B: tawwa madhi sa3a w-nuss.
A: shbiha fatma ma-fatrit-sh?
B: ma-fatrit-sh 3la khatir qa3da tistanna fi-sahbitha layla.
A: waqtash layla wislit l-il-mat3am?
B: wislit madhi sa3tin.
A: shbiha jat mmakhkhar yasir?
B: jat mmakhkhar 3la khatir ma-3arfit-sh win ja l-mat3am.
A: ash 3amlu fatma w-layla?
B: talbu l-karta.
A: shniyya l-makla lli mawjuda f-il-mat3am?
B: famma barsha 7ajat: brik w-shurba w-maqruna w-djaj musli w-hut muqli.
A: ash talbit fatma?
B: talbit brika b-it-tunn w-djaj musli w-sahn ghalla.
A: ash sharbit ba3d li-ftur?
B: sharbit qahwa 3arbi.
A: ash fatrit layla?
B: fatrit slata meshwiya w-kuksi.
A: talbit-shi gazuz m3a li-ftur?
B: la, 3la khatir ma-sinha-sh f-il-gazuz. ama talbit dabbuza ma.
A: khdhat-shi desar?
B: la, ma-khdhat-sh desar 3la khatir shab3it.
A: qaddash tla3 la-7sab?
B: la-7sab tla3 tis3-alaf.
A: shkun khallas li-ftur?
B: khallsittu layla.

Text: rumdhan
rumdhan mafrudh 3la-l-muslimin il-kull, ama l-murdha w-li-msafrin ma-lazimhum-sh ysumu.
shhar rumdhan ma-yji-sh dima fi-nafs il-waqt 3la khatir il-3am il-hijri aqsar m-il-3am il-miladi, hathaka 3lash rumdhan yqaddim kull 3am b-7dash-in yum. in-nas ysumu m-is-sba7 l-il-lil. la yaklu w-la yushrbu w-la yitkayyfu.
in-nas yqumu m3a l-fajr qbal-ma tatla3 ish-shams bash yitsahhru w-ba3dha ysalliu slat is-subh. w-min ba3d yirj3u yurqdu.
fi-rumdhan in-nas ytayybu barsha 7ajat bnan: li-brik w-ish-shurba yilzimhum ykunu kull yum 3a-t-tawla.
waqt shaqqan il-fatr famma nas ysalliu f-ij-jami3, w-min ba3d yshuqqu ftarhum. ba3d shaqqan il-fatr barsha nas yitfarriju f-it-talfza 3la khatir jibu musalsalat b-baramij diniya. famma rjal yhibbu yashru f-il-qhawi, ama n-nsa yuq3du f-id-dyar walla ytullu 3la ba3dhum. ahla shahriyat rumdhan 3la khatir il-3ayilat ytullu 3la ba3dhum w-yashru l-is-sba7, khassatan iz-zlabya w-li-mkharaq.
f-in-nhar aghlabit il-qhawi w-li-mta3im ysakkru. in-nas illi ma-ysumu-sh ma-yilzimhum-sh yitkayyfu w-yaklu f-ish-shari3 3la khatir yilzimhum yqaddru n-nas is-saymin.
fi-akhir shhar rumdhan yibdau n-nas yhaddru l-il-3id iz-zghir, yasmlu l-baqlawa w-il-maqrudh w-la-grayyba w-yishriu hwayj jdud l-wladhum.
